::: {.key-question}
What health and wellbeing practices are Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander Peoples living in the NEPHU catchment engaging in?
:::

## Childhood Vaccinations

```{r}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 1 year
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
childhood_year1 <- f_read_hpf_vaccination(data_sheet    = "D3.02.2",
                                          column_select = c(indigenous_status = "x1",
                                                            hepb = "hepatitis_b",
                                                            "dtp",
                                                            "polio",
                                                            "hib",
                                                            pneumo = "pneumococcal",
                                                            fully = "fully_immunised"))

# Data wrangling
childhood_year1 <- childhood_year1 %>% 
  f_wrangle_hpf_vaccination() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(vaccine = factor(dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                               "dtp"    = "DTP",
                                               "hepb"   = "Hepatitis B",
                                               "hib"    = "HiB",
                                               "pneumo" = "Pneumococcal",
                                               "polio"  = "Polio",
                                               "fully"  = "Fully immunised"),
                                levels = c("DTP",
                                           "Hepatitis B",
                                           "HiB",
                                           "Pneumococcal",
                                           "Polio",
                                           "Fully immunised"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::arrange(vaccine)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 2 years
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
childhood_year2 <- f_read_hpf_vaccination(data_sheet    = "D3.02.3",
                                          column_select = c(indigenous_status = "x1",
                                                            hepb = "hepatitis_b",
                                                            "dtp",
                                                            "polio",
                                                            "hib",
                                                            pneumo = "pneumococcal",
                                                            "mmr",
                                                            "varicella",
                                                            menc = "men_c",
                                                            fully = "fully_immunised"))

# Data wrangling
childhood_year2 <- childhood_year2 %>% 
  f_wrangle_hpf_vaccination() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(vaccine = factor(dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                               "dtp"       = "DTP",
                                               "hepb"      = "Hepatitis B",
                                               "hib"       = "HiB",
                                               "menc"      = "Men C",
                                               "mmr"       = "MMR",
                                               "pneumo"    = "Pneumococcal",
                                               "polio"     = "Polio",
                                               "varicella" = "Varicella",
                                               "fully"     = "Fully immunised"),
                                levels = c("DTP",
                                           "Hepatitis B",
                                           "HiB",
                                           "Men C",
                                           "MMR",
                                           "Pneumococcal",
                                           "Polio",
                                           "Varicella",
                                           "Fully immunised"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::arrange(vaccine)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Vaccination coverage - 5 years
# Data from AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read in AIR data
childhood_year5 <- f_read_hpf_vaccination(data_sheet    = "D3.02.4",
                                          column_select = c(indigenous_status = "x1",
                                                            "dtp",
                                                            "polio",
                                                            fully = "fully_immunised"))

# Data wrangling
childhood_year5 <- childhood_year5 %>% 
  f_wrangle_hpf_vaccination() %>% 
  #
  dplyr::mutate(vaccine = factor(dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                               "dtp"       = "DTP",
                                               "polio"     = "Polio",
                                               "fully"     = "Fully immunised"),
                                levels = c("DTP",
                                           "Polio",
                                           "Fully immunised"))) %>% 
  #
  dplyr::arrange(vaccine)
```

- Data for this topic were obtained from the [AIHW Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health Performance Framework](https://www.indigenoushpf.gov.au/).

- 92% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander children living in Victoria were fully immunised at 1 year of age, compared to 94% of non-Indigenous children.

- 90% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander children living in Victoria were fully immunised at 2 years of age, compared to 93% of non-Indigenous children.

- 96% of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander children living in Victoria were fully immunised at 5 years of age, compared to 95% of non-Indigenous children.

#### Figure 9F-1

::: {#fig_9F_1 .fig-tab-title}
**Figure 9F-1:** Vaccination coverage for children enrolled in Medicare at 1 year of age, Victoria, by Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander status, December 2022
:::

```{r}
#
figure_count <- figure_count + 1

childhood_year1 %>% 
  f_bar_grouped_indigenous(x_variable    = vaccine,
                           y_variable    = prop,
                           y_max         = 100,
                           y_breaks      = 10,
                           y_expand      = 1,
                           y_title       = "Percentage of children",
                           x_angle       = 0,
                           legend_offset = -0.1)
```

#### Table 9F-1

::: {#tab_9F_1 .fig-tab-title}
**Table 9F-1:** Vaccination coverage for children enrolled in Medicare at 1 year of age, Victoria, by Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander status, December 2022
:::

```{r}
#
table_count  <- table_count + 1
table_number <- paste0("Table_", table_section, "_", sprintf("%.02d", table_count))

table <- childhood_year1 %>% 
  dplyr::select(-indigenous_status) %>% 
  #
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from  = "indigenous_label",
                     values_from = "prop") %>% 
  #
  janitor::clean_names()

if (!file.exists(paste0(here::here(), "/data/", table_number, ".csv"))) {
  
  write.csv(table, paste0(here::here(), "/data/", table_number, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
}

table %>%
  dplyr::mutate(aboriginal     = sprintf("%.1f", aboriginal),
                non_indigenous = sprintf("%.1f", non_indigenous),
                #
                vaccine = dplyr::recode(vaccine,
                                        "Fully immunised" = "Fully immunised for vaccines<br>due at 6 months of age")) %>% 
  #
  f_table_simple(table_headers = c("Vaccine",
                                   "Yes (%)",
                                   "No (%)")) %>% 
  #
  kableExtra::column_spec(2:3,
                          width = "1.75in") %>% 
  #
  kableExtra::row_spec(nrow(table),
                       extra_css = "vertical-align:middle;") %>% 
  #
  kableExtra::add_header_above(c(" " = 1,
                                 "Identified as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander" = 2))
```

::: {.callout-note title="Data notes" icon=false collapse=false}
`r note_data_framework_air`

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

`r note_caveat_underidentification`

<div style="height: 0.1em;"></div>

- The aspirational national target for vaccination coverage is for 95% of children to be fully immunised at each age point (1 year, 2 years, and 5 years).
  - The 1 year milestone is assessed for children aged 12-15 months at the time of reporting.
  - The 2 year milestone is assessed for children aged 24-27 months at the time of reporting.
  - The 5 year milestone is assessed for children aged 60-63 months at the time of reporting.

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- Children fully immunised for age at 1 year have received all of the following vaccines, due at 6 months of age:
  - Diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis (DTP)
  - Hepatitis B 
  - Haemophilus influenzae type B (HiB)
  - Pneumococcal disease
  - Poliomyelitis
  
<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- Children fully immunised for age at 2 years have received all of the following vaccines, due at 12 and 18 months of age:
  - Diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis (DTP)
  - Hepatitis B
  - Haemophilus influenzae type B (HiB)
  - Meningococcal C (Men C)
  - Measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR)
  - Pneumococcal disease
  - Poliomyelitis
  - Varicella zoster

<div style="height: 1em;"></div>

- Children fully immunised for age at 5 years have received all of the following vaccines, due at 48 months of age:
  - Diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis (DTP)
  - Poliomyelitis
